clips.title: The story
paras: In the snowy heights of the Alterac Mountains, Crushridge ogres hold Slaughter Hollow as a secluded camp. Travelers rarely come here except to hunt ogres or cross the frozen passes.

Slaughter Hollow shelters the Crushridge ogres high in the peaks between Hillsbrad and Alterac. Makeshift fires, scattered bones, and crude shelters mark the mound. Other ogre dens in the highlands often see fights over territory or stolen supplies, but Slaughter Hollow stays quiet and beyond the reach of major military campaigns.

Crushridge ogres sometimes keep prisoners taken along the mountain trails in their secluded mound. Travelers speak of Rizz Loosebolt, an unlucky gnome locked in a crude cage and trying to bargain with anyone who passes. Captives seldom fare well against the clan's appetite.
